blurb: Charters are custom to fit your desires! You will find the true beauty of Lake Tahoe on your tour. Whether that be through sightseeing or fishing, Discover Tahoe Chartered Cruises will take you there! Out premium party pontoon comes with Bluetooth sound, a large Bimini top, swim ladder and water lights. Fishing equipment on the boat includes a Garmin fish finder, pole holders and two downriggers. Sightseeing, party cruising, pier hoping, and fishing are all great options to get your piece of Tahoe on our pontoon. Feel free to bring food, drinks, and alcohol (just no red wine).
